title: Battle of Praia da Vitória
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Praia da Vitória", at revision 1370586590, opens: "The Battle of Praia Bay was fought by the coast of Terceira Island on August 11, 1829, between Portuguese liberals and a Miguelite fleet as part of the Portuguese civil war." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2890321, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1829 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
